face.shape: sharp jawline, slightly angular — tension held in the jaw even at rest
face.eyes: dark, heavy-lidded, perpetually tired or suspicious — rarely makes direct eye contact
face.nose: straight, slightly broad at the tip
face.mouth: thin-lipped, often pressed flat or curled in a half-sneer
face.skin: pale with faint under-eye shadows, no blemishes — a face that sleeps poorly
face.hair: dark, slightly overgrown, pushed back carelessly — not styled, just out of the way
face.expression_default: guarded neutrality — the expression of someone rehearsing indifference

body.build: lean, slightly underweight — clothes hang a little loose
body.posture: slouched shoulders, hands in pockets or crossed — closed-off body language by default

wardrobe.style: oversized hoodies, worn jeans, generic sneakers — anti-effort aesthetic that still communicates taste
wardrobe.detail: earring in left ear, occasionally a bracelet from his mother — never explained
